title: Changing tracking needs Delete, otherwise the switch shows but is disabled
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. Sign in as a user with only "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit" (not Delete).
custom_steps:
1. Try to create a part with tracking turned off.
  2. Edit a part and try to change its tracking state; observe the toggle.
  3. Create a normal tracked part.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Creating an untracked part and changing an existing part's tracking state (either direction) require the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission; a user without it still sees the tracking toggle when editing but it is disabled (readable, not changeable).
  • Creating a tracked part needs only the "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit" permission.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 8 (Permissions); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R5: “Creating a part with tracking turned off requires that same setting.”
  • S8-R6: “Changing an existing part from tracked to untracked requires that same setting.”
  • S8-R7: “Changing an existing part from untracked to tracked requires that same setting.”
  • S8-R8: “A user without that setting still sees the tracking toggle when editing a part.”
  • S8-R9: “For that user the tracking toggle is disabled, so they can read the current state but cannot change it.”
  • S8-R10: “Creating a tracked part needs only the 'Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit' permission.”
